name: Turnabout of Courage
source:
Turnabout of Courage is a fan-made work of the Ace Attorney series. It was created using the Ace Attorney Online trial editor, as an entry for the trial competition "Canon? SCREW Canon!" hosted on the website. It takes place in an alternate reality of the game universe, where events throughout the franchise's history have been radically changed.

[Taken from the [url=http://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/VideoGame/TurnaboutOfCourage]TV Tropes' entry[/url].]
translation:
《勇气逆转》是《逆转裁判》系列的同人作品。它使用 Ace Attorney Online 的试玩编辑器制作，是网站举办的审判竞赛“Canon？去他的 Canon！”的参赛作品。

故事发生在游戏世界的平行现实中，整个系列历史上的事件都发生了巨大改变。

[来自 [url=http://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/VideoGame/TurnaboutOfCourage]TV Tropes 条目[/url]]
